title: AikiField — Services
author: AikiField
exact_source_text: Engagements built around the outcome you need. Every engagement is designed to meet your security maturity and business stage — and to move a metric your business actually cares about. Flagship CISO-level leadership without a full-time hire. Get executive security leadership that wins enterprise deals and keeps pace with your roadmap — 20+ years of CISO experience, practical AI in security engineering, and customer-trust advisory in one monthly engagement. Best for: Series A–C startups, SaaS companies, AI-powered product teams, and anyone facing enterprise security requirements. Win enterprise deals — a security roadmap and risk prioritization aligned to your stage and revenue model. Ship AI features safely — a governance framework covering model security, data handling, and AI risk. Fix vulnerabilities in days, not weeks — AI-assisted triage and remediation workflows (21 days → 3). Clear questionnaires without panic — customer-trust advisory, deal enablement, and compliance readiness. Make sound calls under pressure — security decision coaching for founders and CTOs. Always-on support — monthly strategy, async help, and incident availability. Program buildout. A security program right-sized to your risk. Cover your real risks without an enterprise-sized budget.
